title: IKEA PAX with mirror doors and cupboards to the ceiling
summary: IKEA PAX wardrobes with mirror doors on a 170 mm base, with made to measure MDF cupboards across the whole wall above, over the door too, and a panel to a 3.4 metre ceiling.
intro: A bedroom with a 3.4 metre ceiling, a wall 2480 mm wide and the door at one end. Two IKEA PAX frames with mirror doors stand on a 170 mm base, and above them a row of MDF cupboards 645 mm high runs the full width of the wall, including a cupboard that floats over the door. A blank MDF panel takes it the last 600 mm or so to the ceiling.

steps.title: A tall room
steps.text: A bedroom with a 3.4 metre ceiling and a wall 2480 mm wide, with the door at the right hand end. The plan: IKEA PAX wardrobes with mirror doors on the left, and made to measure MDF cupboards across the whole wall above, over the door as well.

image.alt: The room before, with the door on the right of the wall

steps.title: A 170 mm base
steps.text: The PAX frames stand on a timber base 170 mm high, set out on the floor and levelled first, so the wardrobes sit level and line up with the cupboards above.

image.alt: The timber base on the floor along the wall

steps.title: PAX frames on
steps.text: Two IKEA PAX frames, 201 cm high, go on the base: a 100 cm frame and a 50 cm frame. Above them the first MDF cupboards are already up.

image.alt: The two white PAX frames on the base, with open MDF cupboards above

steps.title: Cupboards above, 645 high
steps.text: The top cupboards are 645 mm high and made in MDF, three of them sitting on the PAX frames and lined up with the doors below.

image.alt: The PAX frames from further back, with the MDF cupboards above

steps.title: Floating over the door
steps.text: The tricky part was the cupboard over the room door. It floats, with nothing under it, so it is fixed to the side of the cupboards over the PAX section and to the wall.

image.alt: The mirror doors on and the cupboards running over the room door

steps.title: Doors on the cupboards
steps.text: Flat MDF doors on soft close hinges go on all five top cupboards, and a blank MDF panel takes it up to the ceiling, about 600 mm.

image.alt: The cupboard doors on, from the corner of the room

steps.title: Inside the PAX
steps.text: The wide frame has two hanging rails, one above the other. The narrow one has wire baskets and shelves.

image.alt: The mirror doors open: two rails on the left, shelves and baskets on the right

steps.title: Finished
steps.text: Mirror doors below, MDF cupboards above, and the panel to the ceiling: the whole wall used from floor to ceiling.

image.alt: The finished wall, mirror doors below and MDF cupboards above, with the door open

model3d.title: The wall in 3D
model3d.text: Drawn in 3D to the sizes in my notes: a wall 2480 mm wide and 3400 mm high, a 170 mm base, PAX frames 201 cm high and cupboards 645 mm high. The filler, the end panel by the door and the fittings inside are drawn from the photos. Open the doors, or take it apart.
